messages:
alex: Morning — quick async checkin for API GW / routing / auth / rate limits. Post a short 3-line: what I did / blocker / today. I'll go first.

alex: what I did: landed small metrics patch for route tagging (PR #482) so latency per-route shows up in console.
alex: blocker: seeing a handful of 429s from the mobile beta, unclear if client is retrying too aggressively or if the rate policy is too tight.
alex: today: triage 429s, add a short-term per-ip burst allowance, ping infra for additional canary capacity.

maggie: what I did: updated routing policy DSL to support weighted fallbacks, test coverage added. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/487
maggie: blocker: need an opinion on default fallback priority order (region -> model-variant -> tier).
maggie: today: merge DSL change after a quick thumbs-up, wire into canary routing.

pranav: what I did: rotated auth signing keys in staging and validated token expiry handling.
pranav: blocker: during rotation a handful of long-lived embeddings jobs failed because they didn't refresh client creds.
pranav: today: add explicit token refresh guidance to SDK and backfill a short-lived refresh check in the job runner. @maggie can we surface an auth-mismatch metric in routing logs? :eyes:

sarah: what I did: ran distributed rate-limit sim with synthetic traffic (locust), got repro of 429s when burst=50 and sustained qps=120.
sarah: blocker: the rate limiter's bucket refill math diverges for large counts under quantized windowing; need either finer granularity or a different algorithm.
sarah: today: open a tiny RFC with two options and a perf microbenchmark to decide. sending sample config below for review:

sarah: ```
rate_config:
  key: "route+ip"
  window_ms: 1000
  capacity: 120
  burst: 60
  strategy: "leaky_bucket"
```

sarah: please eyeball if burst=60 looks sane for mobile clients (we saw spikes ~45).

deploy-bot: Canary deploy redwood-gateway:v2.13 to us-east-1 completed (canary: 3/3 healthy). :shipit:

alex: quick ask — who can review the rate-config change in the runtime? I pushed a branch `rate-refine` with the leaky_bucket impl. Need one +1 before I flip the default.

maggie: I can look in 30m.

pranav: I'll check auth impacts in the job-runner after lunch, ping me for a review.

sarah: one more datapoint: locust summary attached (p95 token latency 85ms, p99 210ms, 429 rate 3.1% at burst=50). I'll convert to a small dashboard panel.

alex: plan: merge metrics + canary, hold default rate flip behind a feature flag, follow-up call if 429s persist.
alex: reminder: @oncall please monitor gateway error-rate for next 2 hours, escalate to eng-oncall if >5% 429 or >0.5% 5xx.

maggie: ack.

pranav: ack.

sarah: ack, will post dashboard link when ready.

alex: thanks — wrap up here unless someone has anything urgent. :thumbsup:
